cmd.remirror: Re-mirror All Objects for AI Tools
cfg.backupBeforeWrite: Create a backup copy of the .accdb file before every write.
cfg.backupOnOpen: Create a timestamped backup copy of the .accdb file when it is opened, marking the start of a work session (in addition to the per-write backups).
cfg.backupCount: How many backup copies to keep per database (oldest are deleted).
cfg.backupDebounceSeconds: Minimum seconds between two backups of the same database (0 = backup on every save).
cfg.compileAfterSave: Run a VBA compile check after saving a module and warn if the project does not compile.
cfg.operationTimeoutSeconds: Timeout in seconds for Access COM operations (opening the database and compiling use a fixed 60s).
cfg.vbaUnlockTimeoutSeconds: How many seconds to wait for you to enter the VBA project password in the Access dialog before giving up.
cfg.bypassStartup: Skip the database's Startup form and AutoExec macro when opening it (the classic Shift-bypass technique). Has no effect if the database's AllowBypassKey property was disabled by its developer.
cfg.visibleOperations: Show the Access window and the actual table, module or form/report being read or written, in real time, instead of running fully hidden.
cfg.aiMirror.enabled: Mirror every table, query, form, report, macro and module as a real file on disk (in a .accdb-ai folder next to the database) so AI coding tools such as Claude Code can find and edit them directly. Edits to mirrored files are saved back into Access automatically, with a Revert option.
cfg.reopenOnStartup: Automatically reopen databases that were open in Access Explorer when VS Code restarts or the window is reloaded (e.g. after "Developer: Reload Window"). Turn off to leave databases closed until you reopen them yourself.
